title: Paywall bump
suits: a problem slide where users, agents or orders hit friction: paywalls, logins, checkouts, approvals, rate limits

params.--field: the slide field (dusk violet by default); hills are drawn in its ink
params.--brand: the shop (awning stripes, facade tint), two antenna bulbs, the card's floor tint
params.--brand-2: the wall's bricks and the sign's inner frame (the friction)
params..st-paywall-bump-signt: the sign's text: the friction in two words

details: the lead bot squashes against the wall (scale .84 × 1.08) before it bounces back
it rests knocked back, tilted 7°, pivoting on its rear foot
its eyes switch from dots to > < on the frame of impact
its antenna keeps going forward and whips back and forth, damped, after the body stops
speed streaks trail the lead bot while it runs and vanish on impact
every shadow starts a beat late and catches up, and never tilts with its bot
a dust puff of four circles spreads from the wall's foot
three ink impact ticks flash at the corner of the wall
the wall shakes 7 px and settles
the hanging sign swings on its nail and is left 3° crooked
a crumb of brick falls off the coping, bounces once and stays on the floor
the second bot runs into the lead's back, leans in, and ends up looking up at the sign
the third bot slows down early, leans back, takes a half step back and looks over its shoulder
the last bot sits down with a squash, legs out in front, eyes half closed, and lets out a little sigh
the sitting bot blinks once every 7 s (ambient, after rest)
the shop beyond the wall glows, its door light spilling across the floor, breathing slowly
a pale far town on the horizon gives the card depth
